question: If the volume of a rectangular parallelepiped is 240 cm³ and its base area is 30 cm², what is its height?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Height of a parallelepiped = Volume ÷ Base Area

Height = 240 ÷ 30

Height = 8 cm

**∴ Answer = 8 cm**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Volume of rectangular parallelepiped = 240 cm³

Base Area = 30 cm²

**Formula used:**

Volume = Area of base × Height
